name: AG Semiconductor Services, LLC.

about:
AG Semiconductor Services (AGSS) is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. The company was founded in 1999 and has grown into a global remarketer of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

AGSS specializes in the acquisition, refurbishment, and resale of front‑end semiconductor processing tools, IC test and assembly equipment, and printed circuit board assembly systems, primarily sourced from major fab closures. Its service portfolio spans contract remarketing, de‑installation, decontamination, rigging, transport, installation, startup, qualification, and warranty support. Over the past two decades the firm has handled more than 16,000 individual assets and complete fab lines for over 500 customers across 24 countries.

The customer base includes integrated device manufacturers, original equipment manufacturers, and early‑stage chip companies worldwide. AGSS has supplied equipment for fab expansion, conversion, and closure projects, serving the broader electronics manufacturing sector.

The company emphasizes quality, flexibility, and availability as core drivers of its growth. Project managers with direct IDM fab experience oversee each engagement, and refurbishment is performed either in‑house or through qualified third‑party providers, with source inspections completed before shipment.
